mekayis.metin: (وَطَنَ) الْوَاوُ وَالطَّاءُ وَالنُّونُ: كَلِمَةٌ صَحِيحَةٌ. فَالْوَطَنُ: مَحَلُّ الْإِنْسَانِ. وَأَوْطَانُ الْغَنَمِ: مَرَابِضُهَا. وَأَوْطَنْتُ الْأَرْضَ: اتَّخَذْتُهَا وَطَنًا. وَالْمِيطَانُ: الْغَايَةُ.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: وَطَن • (waṭan) m (plural أَوْطَان (ʔawṭān))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root و ط ن (w ṭ n). Originally denoting one's birthplace, the sense broadened to encompass the idea of nation or homland over the 20th century, following the collapse of the Ottoman Empire.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: وَطَنَ • (waṭana) I (non-past يَطِنُ (yaṭinu), verbal noun وَطْن (waṭn))
وَطَّنَ • (waṭṭana) II (non-past يُوَطِّنُ (yuwaṭṭinu), verbal noun تَوْطِين (tawṭīn))
g: to choose for residence; to settle down, get settled, take up residence
to get used to, adjust oneself to, reconcile oneself to; to put up with (نَفْسَهُ عَلَى (nafsahu ʕalā))
to prepare oneself mentally for, to make up one's mind to (نَفْسَهُ عَلَى (nafsahu ʕalā))
